page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance delivers 24 dedicated vCPUs paired with 96.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 8 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included by default.

The hardware configuration does not feature onboard local storage, meaning that all persistent filesystem operations rely entirely on remote network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance contains no dedicated GPU hardware, reserving execution solely to the host CPU cores. This setup provides predictable, non-burstable compute capacity across all allocated vCPUs.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the balanced allocation of memory and processing resources provides an economical footprint for workloads requiring moderate multi-threading without extreme memory density. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.6xlarge is architecturally suited for distributed web application servers, enterprise backend services, continuous integration build nodes, container worker clusters, and mid-tier transactional databases requiring network storage.
